reviews.title: LUTEAL/period/follicular/ovulation SUGGESTION
reviews.text:
Hello! 
Great app. I have a very important suggestion: incorporate phase tracking options so I can switch my fasting plan in accordance to my hormone cycles. It’s so important for women to learn how to support their bodies through changes in the hormone cycle<3 
Plz support us menstruating folk 
-gen z

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service: Cannot Get My Account Cancelled
reviews.text:
Exercise caution with the his company. The app wasn’t helpful and I’ve gotten nothing but silence trying to cancel my account. The only option to communicate with this company is via email. 
I cancelled three months ago and I’m still being billed. I’ve emailed them several times and no response. All I can say is beware. I’m still trying to block my account so they can’t bill me.
